# Bittu's Portfolio & Technical Blog
> A portfolio and technical blog for a low-level systems builder, cybersecurity undergraduate at IIT Kanpur, and WebRTC developer.

## Projects
- [ORV-Reader](https://orv.pages.dev): High-scale distributed web publishing platform serving 10.5M+ monthly HTTP requests (398+ GB bandwidth, 764k+ unique visits). Automated Python Markdown SSG dual-compilation into static web and compressed EPUBs with Cloudflare WAF bot defenses.
- [PeerBasket](https://peerbasket.bittu.dev): High-throughput, lobby-based WebRTC signaling server written in Go with Gin and Redis. Achieves 41 ms average latency and 0.0% packet loss across 500 concurrent peers with Redis TTL heartbeat pruning and IP token-bucket rate limiting on bare-metal Proxmox infrastructure.
- [LOTM-Reader](https://github.com/Bittu5134/LOTM-Reader): Community-driven webnovel reader engineered for ultra-fast reading ergonomics. Built with Svelte, Giscus comment synchronization, Pandoc EPUB compilation pipelines, and offline service worker caching.
- [NetShip](https://github.com/Bittu5134/NetShip): Cross-platform Host Telemetry and Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) daemon in Go. Captures active TCP/UDP socket activity, maps process lineages via deterministic 24-char SHA-256 GUIDs, performs local cryptographic binary auditing, and runs an embedded live geolocation dashboard.
- [IITK-Resume-Engine](https://iitk-resume.bittu.dev): Spatial LaTeX-PDF diagnostic engine built for IIT Kanpur Academics & Career Council (CDW). Features a 2D coordinate geometry table parser in PyMuPDF recognizing 4,400+ IITK courses and CPI metrics, paired with a 6-track step-gradient scoring model and counterfactual gap advice.
- [InfraPulse](https://infrapulse.bittu.dev): Civic defect detection and priority dispatch platform developed for IIT Kanpur Takneek '26. Combines a 5-model PyTorch vision ensemble with Sobel spatial edge severity math, async FastAPI ticket routing, and live Server-Sent Events (SSE) staff dispatch queues.
- [Sharelock](https://github.com/Bittu5134/Sharelock): 1st Place Winner at ShareIITK Ideathon. An end-to-end RAG retrieval pipeline and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server indexing 100+ pages of dense IIT Kanpur Undergraduate Manual academic policies for citation-backed query resolution.
- [SkyBlock-Sniper](https://github.com/Bittu5134/SkyBlock-Sniper): High-frequency Hypixel Skyblock BIN auction sniping automation script in Python. Features real-time Hypixel API polling, memory-efficient profit margin calculation, and millisecond item snipe triggers.
- [GH-Follow-Tracker](https://github.com/Bittu5134/GH-Follow-Tracker): Automated GitHub follower tracking engine with customizable real-time SVG status badges, Discord/Slack webhook notifications, and a REST API deployed on Cloudflare Workers edge network.

## Technical Writing
- [Scaling WebRTC Signaling in Go: Lessons from 500 Concurrent Peers](https://bittu.dev/raw/blogs/scaling-webrtc-signaling-in-go.md): A deep dive into building PeerBasket low-latency signaling server in Go. How we achieved 41ms average latency and 0% packet loss across 500 concurrent peers with Redis TTL heartbeat pruning and IP token buckets. (HTML view at https://bittu.dev/blog/scaling-webrtc-signaling-in-go)
- [Reverse Engineering the Modern Minecraft Network Protocol](https://bittu.dev/raw/blogs/reverse-engineering-minecraft-protocol.md): Unpacking the binary wire format of Minecraft Java Edition. From variable-length integers (VarInt) and zlib packet compression to handshake state machines and live packet sniffing. (HTML view at https://bittu.dev/blog/reverse-engineering-minecraft-protocol)
- [Coordinate Geometry in PyMuPDF: Extracting Unruly Academic LaTeX PDFs](https://bittu.dev/raw/blogs/spatial-geometry-parsing-in-pymupdf.md): Why standard PDF parsers struggle with academic transcripts and resumes, and how we solved it for CDW IIT Kanpur using 2D spatial coordinate clustering and step-gradient scoring. (HTML view at https://bittu.dev/blog/spatial-geometry-parsing-in-pymupdf)
